purpose: Define a provenance-first machine-readable record format for comparative research on spiritual literature, high writings, mythology, philosophy and related literary works.
principles: source claims are preserved separately from researcher interpretation
primary and secondary sources are never silently merged
translation and edition differences are explicit
historical context is evidence, not endorsement
cross-tradition similarity is a hypothesis until independently supported
absence of evidence is not evidence of absence
philosophical interpretation never becomes engineering fact automatically

record_schema.work_type: primary_text | commentary | philosophical_work | mythology | literature | scholarship
record_schema.author_or_attribution: author, attributed author, anonymous, or disputed
record_schema.translation: translator and translation identifier when relevant

passage_records.source_text: short quotation or normalized source representation

forbidden_shortcuts: do not infer truth from antiquity
do not infer truth from number of adherents
do not equate similar vocabulary across traditions without structural analysis
do not treat translated wording as identical to original wording
do not use a modern Gnozis concept as proof that an ancient text intended that concept
do not promote an interpretation to implementation without the PHIL-001 migration gate
